__doc__: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for this solution's identity. Fill these in, then run 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apply-config.ps1' to push the values into every activated starter's own config files. See CLAUDE.md -> 'Solution Config + Apply Script' and Critical Rule 3 for the component naming convention (schema smkb_<prefix>_PascalName, display 'PREFIX - Name'). apply-config.ps1 also RENAMES each activated starter folder to 'SMKB - <Component> - <Type>' and fixes the starter links in the root docs, in the same run: Tables/EnvVars/Flows take their Component from solutionDisplayName, the Power App from powerApps.componentName (falling back to appDisplayName minus the 'SMKB - ' / ' - Dev' wrapper), the site from powerPages.siteName. Do NOT rename a starter folder by hand. Notes: powerPages.siteName is the BARE site name (apply-config derives the 'PREFIX - Name' display form - do not pre-prefix it); powerPages.webUrlSlug is the web address typed at reactivation, conventionally '<prefix>-<kebab siteName>' plus '-dev'/'-stage' (bare for prod) - *.powerappsportals.com is a namespace shared with every Microsoft tenant, so an unprefixed slug is liable to be taken; publisherPrefix and powerApps.region are fixed informational constants; the Power Pages language set is authored in that starter's src/config/solution.ts. This file ships uninitialized (placeholder values); apply-config.ps1 refuses to run until the placeholders are replaced.
